requirements.agency: Florida Legislature; filings via Department of State, Division of Corporations
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs formation, articles of organization, management, and dissolution of limited liability companies
requirements.citation: Fla. Stat. Ch. 605 (Florida Revised Limited Liability Company Act)
requirements.notes: Florida Revised Limited Liability Company Act — governs LLC formation (articles of organization), members/managers, operating agreements, and entity administration; primary statute for LLC-based restaurant formation.
requirements.title: Fla. Stat. Ch. 605

requirements.agency: Florida Legislature; filings via Department of State, Division of Corporations
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs formation, governance, annual reports, and dissolution of business corporations
requirements.citation: Fla. Stat. Ch. 607 (Florida Business Corporation Act)
requirements.notes: Florida Business Corporation Act — governs incorporation (articles of incorporation), corporate powers, directors/officers, registered agent, and annual reports; primary statute for corporation-based restaurant formation.
requirements.title: Fla. Stat. Ch. 607

requirements.agency: Florida Legislature; registered with Department of State, Division of Corporations
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs registration of a fictitious (DBA) business name before transacting business under it
requirements.notes: Fictitious Name Act — requires registration of any business name other than the legal name with the Division of Corporations (sworn statement, newspaper advertisement, 5-year term); needed when a restaurant trades under a brand name.
requirements.title: Fla. Stat. s. 865.09

requirements.agency: Florida Legislature; enforced by Department of Business and Professional Regulation, Division of Hotels and Restaurants
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs licensure, sanitation, and operation of public lodging and public food service establishments
requirements.notes: Authorizes the Division of Hotels and Restaurants to regulate public lodging and public food service establishments — the core state license (ss. 509.241-509.302) every Florida restaurant must hold.
requirements.title: Fla. Stat. Ch. 509

requirements.agency: Florida Legislature; levied by counties and municipalities
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs county/municipal local business tax and the local business tax receipt
requirements.notes: Authorizes counties and municipalities to levy a local business tax for the privilege of engaging in business and issue a local business tax receipt; every Florida business location typically needs one from each local jurisdiction.
requirements.title: Fla. Stat. Ch. 205

requirements.agency: Florida Legislature; administered by Department of Revenue
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs sales and use tax collection, dealer registration, transient rentals, and the local-option food and beverage tax
requirements.notes: State sales and use tax (6% on retail sales of tangible personal property and taxable services, s. 212.06); restaurants must register as dealers and remit tax on food/beverage sales; also covers transient rentals and local-option food/beverage taxes.
requirements.title: Fla. Stat. Ch. 212

requirements.agency: Florida Legislature; administered by Department of Revenue
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs state corporate income tax on corporations doing business in Florida
requirements.notes: Florida Income Tax Code — imposes corporate income tax on corporations conducting business in Florida; LLCs classified as partnerships for federal tax purposes are not subject; applies to restaurant entities taxed as corporations.
requirements.title: Fla. Stat. Ch. 220

requirements.agency: Department of Business and Professional Regulation, Division of Hotels and Restaurants
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs implementing rules for hotel/restaurant licensure, inspections, and food-service sanitation under Ch. 509
requirements.notes: Rule chapters 61C-1 (General), 61C-3 (Public Lodging Establishments), 61C-4 (Public Food Service Establishments), 61C-5 (Elevator Safety), 61C-7 (Resort Condominiums/Dwellings), 61C-8 (Hospitality Training Grants); implements the Ch. 509 licensing, inspection, and sanitation standards.
requirements.title: FAC Title 61C (Division of Hotels and Restaurants)

requirements.agency: Department of State, Division of Corporations
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — would govern administrative filing procedures for entity formation, annual reports, and fictitious names
requirements.notes: Division of Corporations is confirmed as Division 1N under the Department of State on flrules.org, but the specific filing-rule set (chapter/rule numbers for articles, annual reports, fictitious names) was not readily located; needs a future targeted lookup.
requirements.title: FAC Division 1N (Division of Corporations) rule set

requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs the county local business tax receipt and the certificate-of-use required before a business may operate
requirements.citation: Miami-Dade County Code Ch. 8A, Art. 9 & 10 (business tax); certificate-of-use (zoning)
requirements.notes: County-issued local business tax receipts cite County Code Ch. 8A, Art. 9 & 10 as authority; a certificate of use (zoning/building inspection clearance) is separately required to operate — official code-chapter pages on municode not opened, so entry is recorded but unverified.
requirements.title: Miami-Dade County Code business-tax / certificate-of-use provisions

requirements.agency: Florida Legislature; enforced by Department of Business and Professional Regulation, Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco
requirements.applies_when: citation index entry — governs manufacture, distribution, and sale of alcoholic beverages; out-of-scope-for-now for the restaurant pack
requirements.notes: Beverage Law administration (s. 561.02) — state retains primary regulatory authority over alcoholic beverage manufacture, distribution, and sale via the Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco; indexed now, deferred from current pack scope.
requirements.title: Fla. Stat. Ch. 561
